column1: # Jakarta Faces (JSF) Facelets counters (.xhtml views and composite components), for a rule with
# the prompt file-body-view: the counters of xml-facts, its [ignore] line included, then the view's
# own. "input fields" counts the input, select, textarea, password and checkbox components, not the
# f:selectItem and f:selectItems options inside a select. "EL method bindings" counts an action, actionListener, listener or valueChangeListener
# attribute bound to a #{} expression, the calls a view makes into its beans; "templates and
# includes" every ui:composition, ui:decorate, ui:include and ui:insert. ViewFactPatternsTest pins
# every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
